$comment: Every Cloudflare API token seen in the eight accounts, by name and observed scope: never a value (DOM-776). Collected 13 October 2026 from token lifecycle events and 30 days of audit logs, because the session's cf login cannot read token policies or expiry (403). observed_scope is what the token did, not its granted policy. expires is unknown until a read-only API Tokens Read token per account is available.
target: A deploy token is account-owned, Workers Scripts edit only (plus the bindings that Worker needs), on one account, with an expiry, held in Doppler dd-deploy/<config> and fetched per run over OIDC.
